authority: Source/docs/history -> evidence -> Markdown atlas -> this derived index. Read section caveats and current source before implementing.

service_lifecycle.summary: Native Service runtime owns state transitions and monitoring; Python subclasses implement device-specific lifecycle hooks.

canonical_examples.why: Python wrapper, argument parsing, logger and extended testbed proxy.
Authoritative lifecycle, state, safety, thread and error behavior.
Minimal executable service shape and cooperative main loop.

orchestration.summary: Testbed manages service definitions, discovery, dependency ordering, processes, startup and shutdown.

canonical_examples.why: Configuration intake, entry-point discovery, service process coordination and request handlers.
State/process bookkeeping and stop/interrupt/terminate behavior.
Python access to service instances and testbed information.

configuration.summary: Ordered YAML files become named configuration sections; service/module and proxy/class entry points provide extension discovery.

canonical_examples.why: Small complete example of ordered merge, NumPy-style docs and filename sections.
SafeLoader extension for config-relative !path values.
Current service-module and proxy-class registration forms.

datastream.summary: DataStreams expose bounded arrays with frame IDs; binding validation and copy/lifetime semantics define safe interoperability.

canonical_examples.why: Compact behavioral specification across dtype/shape and invalid submission cases.
Python validation, GIL handling, argument names and array conversion.
Frame metadata, buffer modes and native API definitions.

camera_service.summary: CameraService factors acquisition/ROI/orientation/streams; current concrete v2 drivers provide vendor hooks.

canonical_examples.why: Shared acquisition loop, exposed properties, orientation and temperature stream.
Temporary stop/restart around properties requiring acquisition pause.
Concrete initialized hardware, stopped-acquisition flags and base hook implementation.

camera_service.coverage_note: None dedicated to the camera base or v2 driver in default tests; DataStream tests cover only the stream substrate.

deformable_mirrors.summary: Generic DM base owns channel aggregation; BMC factors voltage conversion; proxies convert commands/maps and apply shapes.

canonical_examples.why: Shared channel creation, monitoring, lock and send_surface hook.
Shared calibration, clipping/discretization and send_to_device seam.
Shape conversion, channels, apply_shape and persistence helpers.

motor_service.summary: PI stage driver/simulator show command, property and stream interfaces around configured axes.

canonical_examples.why: Explicitly recommended by services documentation; current axis/telemetry/worker example.
Interface counterpart with instantaneous simulated moves.

motor_service.coverage_note: None dedicated to this driver in root tests.

simulation.summary: Simulator schedules time-dependent actions; OpticalModel registers/caches optical planes and invalidates dependent propagation.

canonical_examples.why: Callback, camera integration/readout and device action extension contracts.
register_plane, set/get_wavefronts, purge_plane and temporary propagation cache.
Concrete small model paired with an automated propagation test.

experiment.summary: Experiment handles nested run directories, metadata/config snapshots and logging around three execution hooks.

canonical_examples.why: run lifecycle, output path templates and nested experiment bookkeeping.

experiment.coverage_note: None direct in root tests at this snapshot.

logging.summary: Existing handlers bridge Python logging into CATKit2; observers distribute/write/display logs and tracing captures intervals.

canonical_examples.why: Python LogRecord to native log entry conversion.
Context-managed output target, file lock and incremental writing.
Existing timing instrumentation used by device bases.

native_transport.summary: Native core/bindings own local broker and server paths, buffer lifetime and Python/native interoperability.

canonical_examples.why: Actual current property/command communication.
Shared-memory broker implementation used by the runtime.
Python override dispatch and GIL-sensitive run/cleanup bridge.

testing.summary: Root pytest covers primitives/proxy behavior with arrays and dummy services; CI supplies a native conda build on three OSes.

canonical_examples.why: Session process fixture, explicit dummy service registration and teardown.
Actual install/test command and OS matrix.
Selective static checks and exclusions.

public_api.summary: Python proxies turn named service properties, commands and streams into attributes while allowing specialized interfaces.

canonical_examples.why: Dynamic get/set dispatch and installed proxy-interface lookup.
Small specialized client with copied-frame generator and compatibility wrapper.
